The KeyE interactions target the tile in front of me, not my own tile. I'm stuck inside the notice board and can't move. 

Let me reconsider — maybe the movement is blocked because the game needs a different approach. Let me try holding two directions at once, or check if there's a "wait" that resolves. Actually, let me try pressing KeyE facing down toward (2,8) which is walkable — no, that's just interact.

Let me try a very long single-direction hold with the until condition to detect if I ever move.
